summary: USTRY/USDC on Stellar's SDEX had near-zero liquidity and no trades in the 15 minutes before the attack. Reflector is a VWAP oracle, so a single malicious trade defined the pricing window, inflating USTRY from ~$1.00 to ~$106 (100x). The attacker borrowed against the inflated collateral on YieldBlox's Blend V2 pool, draining ~$10.2M. Reflector, Stellar, and Blend all worked as designed; the gap was integrator-side (no deviation/liquidity/thin-sampling guard).

notes: Loss figure $10.2M per Halborn/protos/QuillAudits; some outlets report $10.8M. Prices are the real reported magnitudes; the deviation guardrail is time-invariant, so the harness assigns synthetic in-window ledger timestamps (real attack date in `date`).
